player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nisun formato de mossa valido trovà. Dopara [a1b2], par exenpio [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: El rosso no ga pì piase, el nero vinse!
outcome.black_no_pieces: I neri no i ga pì piase, el rosso vinse!
outcome.no_moves: El xugador {player_id} no ga pì mosse.
outcome.draw: El limite de giro xe stà rivà.
